newsitem.title: CANADA: Man drives jeep into Canadian parliament.
newsitem.headline: Man drives jeep into Canadian parliament.

text.p: A man drove his jeep up several flights of stairs leading into the Canadian parliament on Friday before he was overcome by police, police said.

A Reuter reporter at the scene said the blue jeep carrying a Quebec license plate was stuck inside a covered walkway leading to the central entrance of the stone parliament buildings. Officials said no one was hurt.
Police said the man gunned his jeep past the Centennial Flame at the entrance and up the paved lane to the front of parliament's main building.
The car then bounced up a set of stairs to the building's front, leaving rusty chunks from the undercarriage strewn across the stairs.
The Canadian Press news agency said the car narrowly missed a government worker who was cleaning the steps.
It quoted witnesses as saying the man stopped the jeep inside a set of doors leading to the main lobby of parliament, got out of his truck, and started yelling about politicians and the devil.
